theory.intro: AWS S3 Bucket Basics & ACLs is a core security discipline in AWS cloud operations.

sections.heading: Understanding AWS S3 Bucket Basics & ACLs
sections.content: In modern cloud environments, proper configuration of AWS S3 Bucket Basics & ACLs ensures privilege boundaries and access controls prevent unauthorized resource manipulation.

sections.heading: Security Risks & Attack Vectors
sections.content: Misconfigurations related to AWS S3 Bucket Basics & ACLs allow attackers to perform unauthorized reconnaissance, privilege escalation, and persistent access within your cloud tenant.

sections.heading: Defense & Mitigation Strategies
sections.content: Enforce strict principle of least privilege, continuous auditing via CloudTrail/Config, and automated guardrails.

options: Excessive latency in API network calls
Unauthorized privilege escalation or data exposure
question.explanation: Misconfiguring AWS S3 Bucket Basics & ACLs directly breaches privilege boundaries, allowing attackers to access unauthorized resources.

question.text: Which security framework principle best prevents cloud misconfigurations?
question.explanation: The Principle of Least Privilege ensures identities are restricted to minimum required permissions.
